statement_scope: Whole original Problem 21.15: given an infinite set Omega and any subgroup B <= Sym(Omega), ask whether the amalgamated free product Sym(Omega) *_B Sym(Omega) embeds abstractly in Sym(Omega), without requiring an embedding to respect B. Corson gives a negative answer using countably infinite Omega and a non-Borel subgroup B; one counterexample answers the whole universal question. The older, more restrictive B-respecting question is context only.
